mechanism.semantic_change: Populate CUTLASS KernelHardwareInfo.sm_count from the live CUDA device properties; preserve max_active_clusters=0 and every device-kernel template identity.

immutable_scientific_contract.operands: The unchanged official per-token activation and per-tensor weight E4M3FN quantizers feed identical in-process tensors and scales to stock and candidate.
immutable_scientific_contract.mainloop: identical to the pinned stock SwapAB collective
immutable_scientific_contract.epilogue: identical to the pinned stock SwapAB collective
immutable_scientific_contract.comparator: Synchronized stock first call, synchronized candidate first call, finite full output, then bitwise-equal full BF16 output before timing.

mutable_integration.allowed_owner_adapter: Smallest source-name, runtime-manifest, new-output-root, and resident vLLM/CUTLASS source-reuse adaptation in the existing owner entrypoint. It may not change scientific tensors, quantizers, family geometry, CUDA consumer, oracle, timing, or stop rules.
mutable_integration.repair_policy: Retain the same claim and heartbeat through ordinary source staging, build, import, UID, path, API, retrieval, and incomplete-family repairs while the closest measured restart plus terminal/release margin fits.

stage_1.submission: One stock first call and one candidate first call on identical operands.
continue_gate: runtime sm_count is positive and at least 4
shared storage 210944 bytes is within the live opt-in limit
candidate output is bitwise equal to stock

stage_2.condition: Only after every stage_1 gate passes.
stage_2.submission: Continue the unchanged runner through the remaining five families, without replaying sliding_qkv.

release_predicates.decision_bearing: Release available only after a complete bitwise-equality stop or six-row terminal whose identities, layouts, source/module hashes, timing fields, and ledgers satisfy this binding.
release_predicates.geometric_falsification: A positive bound sm_count and legal nonzero grid followed by cudaErrorInvalidConfiguration rejects this source correction as insufficient; persist the launch ledger and release maintenance without replay.
release_predicates.incomplete: Build, import, staging, retrieval, or missing minimum stock/candidate output is not a scientific negative. Retain for bounded same-claim repair until measured fit or the owner deadline requires maintenance release.
release_predicates.unsafe: Release maintenance immediately for an unsafe or unreachable guest.

stop_rule.stage_1: Stop without later families on any illegal launch metadata, CUDA launch failure, nonfinite output, or non-bitwise output.
stop_rule.stage_2: After six bitwise-equal rows, stop without endpoint if any family regresses over 5%, multiplicity-weighted quant-plus-GEMM saving is nonpositive, or projected saving is below 0.001 s/request.
forbidden: replay M16 or the failed zero-grid candidate
change operands, scales, tile, cluster, mainloop, epilogue, accumulator, output, comparator, warmups, or repetitions
load the model or run an endpoint
